decisions.reason: As a multi-model compliance product kept on its own page across two years and fitting the firm's stated expansion in compliance capabilities, it carries enough investment and justification pressure that management is likely to retain it.

Because the web hosting management platform was presented on the home page and described as a flagship direction, the firm's public commitment and likely sunk investment make withdrawal very unlikely.

This configurable managed hosting plan sits close to the core hosting business and remained prominently offered on its own page, so management has little reason to admit failure and is likely to continue it.

Extended PHP security support has the weakest visible commitment because it is newest and only mentioned on the site, but its fit with the firm's security promise still makes continued offering more likely than removal.
